title: types/plugin-dashboard: `DrillDownConfig.report`'s `{ name }` reference arm validates on all three faces, but no renderer resolves it, so the drill lists records and draws no report
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a declared surface the runtime does not honour, with a named location and a measured reproduction, class (c). The declared≠enforced family.

`reach:` UI render path, measured by objectui#11506's dev at objectui `main` `9d9ed5495` through the real `DrillDownDrawer`, with a throwaway probe (dev report `5962572846` on objectui#11506, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). A drill configured with `report: { name: 'saved_report' }` and filter `{ stage: 'Won' }` listed the records (`find('deal', { stage: 'Won' })`) and drew no report.

## Where (read by the seat at objectui `main` `059bf1b59`)
- `packages/types/src/data-display.ts`, `DrillDownConfig.report`: the second arm is `{ name: string }`, a named report reference. Its JSDoc said "Either an inline SpecReport JSON or a named report reference is supported", "against an app-level report registry".
- The arm validates on the TypeScript face, the tolerant face and the strict face (`DrillDownConfigSchema` in `zod/data-display.zod.ts`).
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DrillDownDrawer.tsx` draws a report only for a dataset-bound inline report (`isDatasetBoundReport` after PR objectui#11516). A `{ name }` value is not resolved against any registry, so the drawer falls through to the record list.
- PR objectui#11516 (objectui#11506, in flight) leaves this arm unchanged and rewrites its JSDoc to say what happens. The declaration itself still promises a resolution nothing performs.

Producer census: zero. objectui#11506's dev ran the same census as for the retired `objectName` shape: objectui examples, docs and `apps/console` non-test code, non-test `packages/*`, and objectstack's examples. The controls fired.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)
The family's rule, 「declared means enforced: honour it or retire it」: resolve the name against a report registry the console already has, or retire the arm so the authoring faces refuse `{ name }` by name. With zero producers measured, the start-up rule leans to retiring. A resolver would be a new capability with no pull.

## Sequencing
Same files as PR objectui#11516 (`DrillDownConfig.report`, `DrillDownConfigSchema`, `DrillDownDrawer.tsx`): dispatch after that PR lands.

Reader who acts: triage first (grade), then `domain:ui`. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Dedupe
- REST issue search on objectui (`drillDown report name reference`, `is:issue`): 33 hits. None is about the `{ name }` arm. The nearest are objectui#11506 (in flight, the dataset-bound key), objectui#7352 (closed, the mirror itself) and objectui#6152 / objectui#11070 (open, broad key censuses that do not name this arm).
- REST scan of the 900 most recently created objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, for `drill` with `report` / `name` / `reference`: 2 hits, objectui#11506 and PR objectui#11502, neither about the reference arm.
